source.name: ERN SWR Toolbox Google Sheet
source.description: Monthly real returns for S&P 500 total return and 10-year Treasury, used by ERN SWR paper (SSRN 2920322)

upstream.name: Shiller Irrational Exuberance Dataset
upstream.author: Robert J. Shiller
upstream.relationship: The Google Sheet 'Asset Returns' tab is derived from Shiller columns 9 (real total return price) and 6 (10-year Treasury). The exact transformation applied by ERN is not documented in the public sheet.

acquisition.method: Extracted from ERN public Google Sheet during P4.9 implementation

content.base_row: 1871-01 has empty returns (base month for initial snapshot)
content.notes: Contains October observations not present in the Shiller source. This confirms the Google Sheet is an independent dataset, not a direct Shiller extraction.

downstream.ern_swr_h720.json: Cumulative index levels built from these returns with per-component fee drag (0.0005 p.a.)

index_level_construction.fee: 0.0005 p.a. = 0.0000416667 monthly, applied per-component (equity and bond independently)

base_snapshot.purpose: Ensures first month's net return matches the oracle (initial withdrawal at d_{c-1})
